 Kaashvi Hiranandani urges ScoutOP to set boundaries with Love on Bigg Boss 20 
 By
 TNM (With ANI Inputs) 
 ✓
 25 October 2026, 11:02 am 
 2 min read
 25 Oct 2026 
 ANI Photo | Kaashvi Hiranandani urges ScoutOP to set boundaries with Love on Bigg Boss 20 
 Gaming creator Kaashvi Hiranandani confronted her boyfriend, ScoutOP, over his closeness with fellow Bigg Boss 20 contestant Lovepreet ‘Love’ Kaur Gill during a recent Weekend Ka Vaar episode.
 In a promotional clip for the episode, Kaashvi asked ScoutOP, whose real name is Tanmay Singh, to establish clear boundaries with Love, telling him to “cut her out”. The exchange began after host Rohit Shetty announced a surprise meeting with ScoutOP.

 Kaashvi then questioned ScoutOP about his interactions with Love, asking, “How is the massage parlour going, Tanmay?” She also addressed Love directly, asking, “Do you also behave like that with your brothers?”
 Love responded by saying, “It felt normal to me because I was in pain.” Kaashvi referred to an earlier comment made by ScoutOP comparing her to Love. She challenged him, asking, “How did you think you could compare me with her?”
 ADVERTISEMENT 
 ScoutOP explained that his comparison was about the way Love had been taking care of him, stating, “The comparison was about the way she was taking care of me.” Kaashvi appeared unconvinced and said, “If you wanted to feel at home, you should have stayed there. It makes me feel disgusted.” She insisted that ScoutOP draw a clear line with Love, warning, “If you have even an ounce of self-respect, draw the line and cut her out.”
 The confrontation followed an earlier discussion during the Weekend Ka Vaar episode where Rohit Shetty questioned the nature of ScoutOP and Love’s relationship. He raised concerns about instances in which ScoutOP had massaged Love’s feet, hands, and neck, stating, “When he is massaging your feet, hands and neck, Love, it does not look right. You ask Scout to massage you from behind, and he massages your calves. It is not looking good at all.” ScoutOP defended his actions by saying he also massages actor Mahhi Vij when asked.
 Rohit Shetty cautioned ScoutOP that the closeness portrayed with Love was creating a negative impression on screen.
 ADVERTISEMENT 
 ScoutOP, Love, and Yung DSA have been members of the same group since the start of the season, alongside Aamrapali Dubey and Aasif Khan. As the series progressed, ScoutOP, Love, and Yung developed a close bond, frequently engaging in teasing, physical interactions, and coordinating game strategy.
 Despite public attention on their relationship, ScoutOP and Love have maintained that their connection is like that of siblings.
